_meta.title: LAiDIES episode surface inventory
_meta.purpose: The denominator for the Wednesday Engine: every place an episode can or must feed. The human rules and decision logic live in operations/weekly-engine-ingestion-map.md.
_meta.authority: Inventory contract. content/episodes/episode-{NN}.canon.md remains the editorial source of truth.

policy_values.required: Every episode owes the artifact or an explicit system-level inherited asset.
policy_values.conditional: Every episode must make and record the decision; build only when selected.
policy_values.system: Shared infrastructure checked every release but not recreated every week.

mode_values.merged: Episode record inserted into a shared file/page.
mode_values.manual: Human or GUI production step with evidence.
mode_values.external: Published outside the repository; local proof is required.

surfaces.proof: Ali-approved substance exists before full prose or downstream production.
Teaching gate passes, divergences are ruled, facts are current, and required sections are non-empty.
Every conditional surface is selected, deferred, or not_applicable with a reason.
Generated from canon, provenance-stamped, and never independently authored.
Every factual/product claim has source, scope, caveat, verified date, and recheck need.
Title, teaching order, prior knowledge and next-episode handoff agree.
Written version passes teaching, voice, fact and must-match gates and is refreshed after any semantic recording revision that affects the readable beat.
Public page renders, links, images, metadata, alt text and after-read path pass.
Meaning matches canon; delivery tags and ear spellings do not leak into public copy.
Every listening-session change is classified; semantic changes are reconciled to canon and affected surfaces; intentional spoken variants are recorded; every row is closed before captions/cues.
Public, intended-sound, TTS/song-performance and caption forms are explicit for every override; homographs also record meaning/context and tool/version scope.
Final listening version plays end to end, uses the approved voice, contains the locked close, and has a fully reconciled recording revision log.

Transcript is produced from the exact approved audio, records the words actually spoken with public spelling restored, and resolves every difference from canon/TTS input before captions, cues or fan-out.
Built from the final approved audio after recording reconciliation; alignment coverage clears the calibrated floor and every spoken block has time.
Captions match the final audio word-for-word after public-spelling normalization, omit delivery tags, and are loaded by the player.

One approved checksum-bound master episode cover records title, number, rights, alt text, focal point and crop-safe derivatives for the site, podcast, YouTube and sharing; retired art and arbitrary film frames are ineligible.

Manifest validates against content/data/media-release.schema.json and binds the exact version, audio/video/caption/transcript assets, cover derivatives, metadata, destinations, correction propagation and release receipt.
The LAiDIES-owned feed validates; the item uses the exact admitted audio, title, episode cover and canonical learning-home link; public playback is verified in the activated podcast destinations.

The official channel receives the admitted full visual master, accurate captions/chapters, approved thumbnail, canonical site and related-learning links; title, image, playback and links are verified publicly.

Approved episode song file, title, artist, canonical lyrics, one to three accurate lesson-memory hooks and rights/provenance are recorded; the song works as replayable music rather than a sung summary.

Manifest validates against content/data/media-release.schema.json and binds the exact artist/band, track and release titles, credits, rights, identifiers, territories, audio/lyrics checksums, approved album artwork, derivatives and destination delivery identities.

Tool-facing performance lyrics preserve a traceable mapping to canonical lyrics and record pronunciation spellings, structure/delivery cues, tool/model/version/date and intended meaning without becoming public copy.

Every pronunciation workaround and generated omission/repetition/substitution is resolved; as-recorded lyrics match the approved audio; public lyrics restore standard spelling; semantic, factual and locked-hook changes are reconciled before fan-out.
DJ SunnyV intro names the correct episode/song and plays immediately before it.
Fixed series open/close are present in the episode package; they are not confused with the weekly episode song.
Episode song and DJ intro are registered and play from KSVL and the episode module.
Existing saint song/introduction is cross-linked, or new assets are added only for a genuinely new saint.
Core lesson, three concepts, remember line and practical use stand alone.
Pack bundles Study Sheet, Try-On, Cheat Sheet and cards; it is not only a link to the article.
Episode-specific exercise is selectable, useful in about ten minutes and does not duplicate another episode.
Save/print output is practical, legible and linked from the Study Pack.
Quiz exists under issue key, checks transfer rather than trivia, deep-links to review, and awards correctly.
Concept/character cards have copy, fronts/backs, alt text, pack key and collection wiring.
Every genuinely new or materially corrected term is added once and searchable; repeated terms link to the existing entry.
Relevant durable books are refreshed before a duplicate book is proposed.
New book owns a durable lookup job not served by an existing book and has complete content, cover, index entry and search aliases.
Episode points to the class that demonstrates the relevant screen/action; class facts are rechecked.
New class demonstrates machinery the episode cannot show and does not repeat conceptual teaching.
Live model/version/plan facts are dated and kept out of evergreen narration when they will rot.

Episode contributes only when the Book Fair cadence or a real drop calls for it; price comes from the shared economy, the complete asset exists, redemption changes the balance once, and ownership/use appears in the promised Closet destination.
Episode card appears behind the bar, matches canon verbatim and is reachable from the episode.
The episode explicitly records one saint or no saint with a reason; any saint used has a teaching move, not a cameo.
Every load-bearing reference/outfit source is already findable in the right shop or is added with a useful gloss.
A new mechanic tie is recorded only when it naturally turns the reference into a useful town action.
One outfit, one source, exact accessories/hair and approved reference image are locked before art generation.
Seven named charms, week title, seven building placements, unique slugs and coordinates are wired.

Every eligible action has a shared amount, reason, completion signal, cap/repeat rule and dedupe key; the action credits once, explains the earn, and appears in the same ledger/balance used across town.
The episode explicitly selects a meaningful building stamp action or none; selected actions have a completion signal, dedupe/cap rule, Wallet destination and milestone/fulfilment contract.
Every wired slug has approved transparent art and fallback behavior is not the shipped experience.

The episode has an accurate lesson hook, funny/signature line and final lyric hook; each record preserves source/context/rights metadata, is discoverable through Overheard in SUNNYVAiLE/search, opens the exact song/scene/episode, and approved favorites/shares persist without creating a second wording authority.
Express and Full Tour stops point to the current episode package and completion rewards bank honestly.

An episode companion practises the lesson or moves the visitor toward practising it; every feature declares and fulfils an honest teach, practise, judge, retrieve, activate, encourage, belong or delight job, and a new activity has a distinct purpose beyond the quiz.
Prompt asks for an answer people can safely share, has a destination, and is posted rather than merely drafted.

Card has an independent sending reason, matches postcard visual rules, is added to the picker and sends successfully; any stated connection reward uses the approved stage, cap, attribution and fulfilled grant rather than being inferred from a share click.
The WEDNESDAY Edition announces the episode and links to it without duplicating the full lesson.
A real adjacent argument/tension is sourced, not already covered, and belongs outside the episode's teaching spine.
Every teaching beat has a visual job, approved references and a stated motion budget.
Hero, section art and scene frames pass continuity, identity, text, style, dimensions and alt-text review.
Every cue resolves to an asset, follows audio timing and clears cue coverage checks.
Selected beats move for a reason, stills remain still where appropriate, and no identity/style drift is introduced.
Project opens, assets are linked, timing/captions are correct, and an editable project is retained.
Final export plays end to end on desktop/mobile with audio, captions and no missing frames.
Episode is selectable, poster/caption tracks load, deep links work and drafts remain hidden.
Archive poster, player thumbnail and social/OG crop exist with correct title and safe zones.
Episode status, URLs, modules, song and release date agree and draft visibility is correct.
Episode and every new book/class/activity have entries, plain-language aliases and valid URLs.
Topic search returns the episode and relevant durable resources; stale legacy entries are corrected.
This-week panel, ritual links, hero media and release state show the new episode.
Episode appears in season order and the Chick Flicks shelf with working read/watch/listen paths.
Canonical URL, title, description, social metadata, structured data and sitemap entry are correct.
Episode links to prerequisites and next steps; books/classes/news link back without orphan pages.
Wednesday Postcard has final URLs, useful excerpt, module links and scheduled/sent proof.

The batch considers stop, wonder, learn, save/send, join, visit/use and return; the connection mystery has a real episode answer; each released CTA has an exact public URL, promised action, UTM/event and mobile/desktop/new-user proof.

Discovery Reel, saveable carousel, Story sequence/poll, caption, CTA, alt text and visual files are complete; at least one object gives standalone value and the batch does not confuse seven social jobs with seven mandatory posts.
Founder-voice post makes the practical/professional case and links to the episode with release proof.
Active-channel cut is vertical, captioned, posted/scheduled and linked; otherwise record channel inactive.
Short is vertical, captioned, has description/link and public/scheduled proof.
Full video, thumbnail, captions, chapters, description and public URL are recorded.
Every selected post has platform, primary job/signal, asset, CTA, exact public URL/UTM, promised site action, public destination proof, scheduled/published timestamp and journey-result fields.

Before the first SUNNYVAiLE growth campaign, the narrative reset, retired Grimoire routes, first-visit comprehension, promised journeys, backend plumbing, social profiles, public smoke tests and post-reveal stability window are signed off; later releases preserve that contract.

The public experience is period-specific and immersive; direct learning remains rigorous; promoted features fulfil an honest hidden-curriculum job; music carries accurate retrieval hooks; one clear visit path reveals optional abundance progressively without confusion.

Butterfly clips are the one universal spendable currency; earning and spending use one auditable ledger; collectibles remain distinct; balances reconcile everywhere; failed transactions do not charge; every redeemed reward exists and arrives where promised; core learning is never clip-gated.

Each active building card separates passive visit history from meaningful stamps, uses one shared stamp/milestone ledger, cannot be refresh-farmed, grants fulfilled rewards once, syncs with the Town Wallet and remains optional progressive depth.

The postcard pilot separates sent/opened/joined/activated states, uses durable opaque attribution, grants capped send rewards and reciprocal join rewards idempotently, fulfils every background/collectible, protects contacts and personal notes, and never pays for spam volume.

Meaningful build learnings are captured across chats with observation separated from diagnosis; verified entries change a real internal control; public derivatives are sourced, reproducible where applicable, privacy/IP-safe, practically useful and linked to their publication evidence.
Derivative has an audience job and does not delay teaching; commercial items remain dormant until explicitly approved.
One record contains approvals, canon hash, deployed URL, media URLs, email/social evidence, known deferrals and rollback note.
Teaching, links, assets, cues, console, desktop/mobile, keyboard, reduced motion, captions, search, reward-ledger reconciliation, connection/referral grants and redemption fulfilment checks pass.

Episode, Study Pack, quiz, song, quote/source opens, game, charm, clip earns/spends/redemptions, invite stages/reciprocal grants, build-learning derivatives and social actions have named events; Friday review records what happened.
Episode remains findable after rollover, current-week modules advance safely, and next episode inherits unresolved follow-up.
